issue.detail: Moore output timing uncertain: registered next-cycle vs combinational same-cycle. Distinguishing sequence: areset=0,x=1 then areset=0,x=0. Registered Moore gives z=1 then z=1; combinational gives z=1 then z=0.
issue.alternative: z is combinational and visible same cycle (z=x in S0, z=~x in S1)

issue.detail: R4 condition says 'if state==S0 and x==1 then next state=S1; else state unchanged' but does not specify state transition when in S1 (stays S1). Also does not state z update timing relative to state transition.
issue.alternative: state transitions to S1 on first x=1 and remains S1 thereafter until reset
